effects.printed_clause: Reveal this card in hand and 1 other "Ohmen" monster in Deck; Special Summon both, with an all-turn "Ohmen"-only Special Summon restriction; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition checks a custom activity counter for prior non-Ohmen summons, reveals this card plus a selected Deck Ohmen during cost, applies an oath Special Summon lock through end turn, and SpecialSummonSteps both together.

official_references.matched_structure: Paired Special Summon plus all-turn archetype-only oath restriction/activity-counter pattern.

effects.printed_clause: If used as Link Material: target an "Ohmechanic" you control and place Current Counters equal to your "Ohmen" monsters; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_BE_MATERIAL with REASON_LINK targets a face-up Ohmechanic and adds the current face-up Ohmen count under a separate HOPT key.

official_references.matched_structure: Material-use trigger registration and delayed optional operation.

coverage_override.reason: The reveal/two-monster Summon procedure, all-turn Ohmen lock, and first HOPT are one activated effect; the Link-material trigger, Current Counter operation, and second HOPT are the other.
